description: This file contains implementation of string utilities for the GN build system, including string interpolation, error handling, and string comparison functions.

methods.name: ErrInsideStringToken
methods.description: Constructs an error indicating a range inside a string token, adjusting for quotes.

methods.name: AppendInterpolatedExpression
methods.description: Parses and evaluates an expression inside string interpolation syntax ${}.

methods.name: AppendInterpolatedIdentifier
methods.description: Appends the value of an identifier from scope into the output string.

methods.name: AppendStringInterpolation
methods.description: Handles string interpolation for $identifier and ${expression} formats.

methods.name: AppendHexByte
methods.description: Parses a hex byte literal in string interpolation, e.g., $0xFF.

methods.name: ExpandStringLiteral
methods.description: Expands a string literal with interpolation into a plain string.

methods.name: EditDistance
methods.description: Calculates the Levenshtein distance between two strings with a maximum threshold.

methods.name: SpellcheckString
methods.description: Finds the closest matching word from a list based on edit distance.

methods.name: ReadStdin
methods.description: Reads all data from standard input into a string.
